question.text: Aspirin can be prepared by the reaction of

options.text: Salicyldehyde with acetic anhydride in presence of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$
Salicylic acid with methanol in presence of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$
Salicylic acid with acetic anhydride in presence of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$
Cinnamic acid with acetic anhydride in presence of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$

solution.text: Asprin is prepared by reaction of salicylic acid with acetic anhydride in presence of $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$
